newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil unchanged, dollar dampens demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil unchanged, dollar dampens demand.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were steady in lethargic business slowed by the strong dollar on Tuesday, traders said.
Outright values were also stable. The front month August IPE contract was unchanged at 1200 GMT at $167 a tonne.
Prompt heating oil on the key ARA barge market was bid at around August IPE plus 25 cents and offered at plus 75 cents.
Barges for second half August were bid at around plus 50 to 75 cents and offered at August plus $1.25.
Demand was again drained by the high dollar, which was trading at around 1.8339 to the mark, making product prohibitively expensive in Europe's main heating oil market.
Low sulphur diesel barges were offered at $4 and $4.25 over August IPE. Bids came from August IPE +$3.50 and +$3.75.
Cargoes were discussed at around unchanged levels in very slow morning discussion.
A cargo of EN590 for August 1-5 was offered at August IPE +$3.75. Russian heating oil was offered at August IPE +$0.50 and bid 50 cents under the screen.
